No item qualifies this week. We rank themes by distinct account and channel names first, then X engagement. Coverage from both vendors and media breaks remaining ties. We use reviewed keyword rules for English clusters and sentiment. We leave other languages unclassified. Percentages describe the retained sample, not all readers. themes.name: Attackers target developer accounts, packages and plugins, including a 1Password breach
themes.why_line: Attackers use developer accounts, code repositories and package registries to reach production systems and customer data.
themes.summary: An attacker hijacks a 1Password employee's GitHub account, injects backend code and steals customer data and source code. 1Password says that password vaults remain untouched.
